results.text: How does an idea get from a draft all the way to paper trading with real allocated capital?
results.answer: Sir, an idea climbs a fixed staircase, and each step has a bar set before any data is seen. A draft is noted, you say yes, and the study is written down and tested on 2000-2023 only at the strict pass mark. It then runs as a paper trial on live sessions for 20 sessions and must beat chance and the average stock on 10 separate days after costs. Only then, with a check that no future data leaked in and your yes, may the allocated paper capital use it; real money needs a final gate on top.
